thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: Spike in 5xx + timeouts detected for /v1/generate across us-west after recent canary deploy. p95 from 120ms -> 2.1s, p99 ~ 5.6s. Error rate 5xx up to 9%. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/alerts/3125

sara: I'm oncall. grabbing dashboard now. any deploy info?

matt: pushed canary @deploy/2026-03-15T10:32 UTC, variant=opt-quant-3, traffic ramp 15% 10:34

anika: seeing gateway timeouts spike exactly aligned with that ramp. suspect kernel/quant path mismatch causing long tail.

leo: @sara @matt is the canary still live? can we cut traffic to it?

matt: yes it's still at 15% on us-west. i can scale it down or rollback.

sara: prioritize minimizing customer impact. start rollback if we can do it <5m. amy-cs can you pull support queue impact?

amy-cs: pulling CS tags. So far 12 tickets referencing "service slow" and 7 customers reporting timeouts in the last 10m — mostly developer integrations. Not yet a large-scale outage but trending.

anika: quick triage commands i ran: 
```
# sample tail of runtime logs with kv cache timestamps
[2026-03-15T10:35:02Z] /worker/42 latency=2100ms req_id=abc123 model=opt-quant-3
[2026-03-15T10:35:03Z] /worker/42 KVCache miss count spike
[2026-03-15T10:35:04Z] ...
```
looks like KV cache pressure + slow attention kernels under certain seq lengths.

matt: i can do immediate rollback to previous stable build (deploy/2026-03-15T09:10). do we want full rollback or scale canary to 0%?

leo: rollback is cleaner given pattern. scale-down might leave corrupted instances around. yes do rollback.

sara: agreed. execute rollback. communicate to customers. @deploy-bot please run rollback and announce.

deploy-bot: executing rollback to deploy/2026-03-15T09:10. estimated completion 2-3 minutes. CI checks OK.

matt: running `rbctl rollback --to 2026-03-15T09:10 --service api-gateway --region us-west`

anika: while rollback is in progress, add temporary circuit-breaker on postfix route to avoid retries: `route config update --circuit-breaker 30%`

sara: @oncall-handoff-bot please note this incident oncall handoff: initial pager handled by sara, handing to matt for follow-up post-rollback.

oncall-handoff-bot: handoff noted: from sara -> matt at 3125000120.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 3125000185. traffic for canary removed, serving version revert to 2026-03-15T09:10.

anika: metrics starting to improve — p95 down to 180ms, p99 450ms, 5xx back to baseline ~0.3%. still watching.

amy-cs: informing affected customers with templated note. will escalate any critical accounts to SEs.

sara: thanks. action items: (1) create urgent postmortem runbook entry, (2) reproduce KV cache pressure locally with quant variant, (3) add canary sig ramp gating for latency tail. matt/anika own.

matt: ack. i'll pin the rollback changelist and disable auto-ramp for this model until we validate.

anika: capturing logs and traces: https://jaeger/trace/3125 and saving slices to /incidents/3125000000/artifacts.

sara: closing incident channel once p99 stable for 30m. for now keep thread open for handoff to matt for post-rollback investigation. good job team. :thumbsup:
